records.name: John Smith

records.notes: Knee reconstruction surgery in 2024. Keep back squats at moderate load and monitor depth. Avoid high-impact jumping.

records.goals: General conditioning, consistency, and core activation.
records.notes: Prefers high-intensity interval formats. Enjoys kettlebell workouts. Heart rate spikes quickly; monitor recovery times.

records.name: Mike Chen
records.goals: Hypertrophy, upper body definition, and consistent training frequency.
records.notes: No current injuries. Very consistent with sleep and nutrition tracking.

records.goals: Marathon prep, aerobic base building, and injury-free mileage progression.
records.notes: Mild lower back stiffness after long runs. Prioritize core stability work.

records.name: Tom Walker
records.goals: General strength maintenance and mobility as a masters athlete.
records.notes: No injuries reported. Prefers morning sessions and steady progression.

records.name: Aisha Khan
records.goals: Postpartum strength rebuild and core recovery.
records.notes: Cleared for training by physician. Avoid heavy overhead loading until week 12.
records.injury: Postpartum recovery — avoid heavy overhead loading until week 12

records.name: Simon
records.goals: Reduce body fat from 17% to below 15% (but not below 10%), build strength, and optimize for health and longevity.
records.notes: Focus on clean compound movements (squat, hinge, press) and metabolic conditioning to improve body composition. Focus on longevity and joint health; monitor RPE and prioritize recovery.

records.name: Barbell Bench Press
records.instructions: Lie flat on a bench, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width, lower it to mid-chest, and push up.

records.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
records.instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, lower the dumbbells to chest level, then press them up.

records.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
records.instructions: Set bench to a 30-45 degree incline. Press dumbbells upwards from chest height.

records.name: Cable Chest Fly
records.instructions: Position pulleys at shoulder height, grab handles, and bring hands together in a wide hugging motion.

records.name: Push-Ups
records.instructions: Keep body in a straight plank, lower chest to floor, and push back up.

records.name: Pull-Ups
records.instructions: Hang from a bar with palms facing away. Pull chest up to the bar.

records.name: Lat Pulldown
records.instructions: Sit at pulldown station, pull bar down to upper chest, engaging the lats.

records.name: Barbell Row
records.instructions: Hinge at hips, pull barbell towards lower abdomen keeping back straight.

records.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
records.instructions: Place one knee/hand on bench, pull dumbbell to hip with other arm.

records.name: Face Pulls
records.instructions: Pull rope attachment from high pulley towards forehead, pulling elbows wide.

records.name: Barbell Back Squat
records.instructions: Rest bar on upper back, squat down until thighs are parallel to floor, push back up.

records.name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
records.instructions: Hinge at hips with micro-bend in knees, lower weight down shins, squeeze glutes to stand.

records.name: Leg Press
records.instructions: Sit in machine, unlock platform, lower knees toward chest, press back up without locking knees.

records.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
records.instructions: Hold a single dumbbell vertically at chest height, squat deep.

records.name: Leg Extension
records.instructions: Sit in machine, extend legs fully, pause at top, and lower slowly.

records.name: Lying Leg Curl
records.instructions: Lie face down, curl roller pad towards glutes, control return.

records.name: Standing Calf Raise
records.instructions: Raise heels as high as possible on a block, stretch down deep.

records.name: Barbell Overhead Press
records.instructions: Press barbell from shoulder height overhead to full lockout, head through at top.

records.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
records.instructions: Stand tall, raise dumbbells out to sides until arms are parallel to the floor.

records.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
records.instructions: Sit or stand, press dumbbells from ear level overhead.

records.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
records.instructions: Rotate palms up as you curl dumbbells towards shoulders, keeping elbows locked at sides.

records.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
records.instructions: Curl dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other).

records.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
records.instructions: Push rope or bar attachment down by extending elbows, keeping upper arms still.

records.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
records.instructions: Lie on bench, lower bar to forehead by bending elbows, then extend.

records.name: Plank
records.instructions: Hold straight body line resting on forearms and toes. Squeeze core and glutes.

records.name: Hanging Knee Raise
records.instructions: Hang from pull-up bar, raise knees to chest height slowly without swinging.

records.name: Abmat Sit-up
records.instructions: Sit with soles of feet together, touch floor behind head, sit up and touch toes.

records.name: Russian Twist
records.instructions: Sit, lean back slightly, lift feet, rotate torso tapping hands side-to-side.

records.name: Walking Lunges
records.instructions: Step forward lunging down, alternating legs.

records.name: Shoulder & Lat Stretch
records.instructions: Hold child pose and lateral lat stretches for 30s.

records.name: Hamstring & Hip Stretch
records.instructions: Static hamstring stretch and hip flexor stretch, hold 30s per side.

records.name: Assault Bike
records.instructions: Sustained air-bike intervals; drive with arms and legs to the calorie target.

records.name: Concept2 Rower
records.instructions: Row to the target distance with a strong legs-hips-arms sequence.

records.name: Ski-Erg
records.instructions: Double-pole the ski-erg to the calorie target, hinging at the hips.

records.name: Watt Bike
records.instructions: Hold the target power output (watts) for the prescribed effort.

records.name: Treadmill Run
records.instructions: Steady-state or interval run to the target time.

records.name: Assault Bike (Time)
records.instructions: Air-bike intervals to a fixed duration — steady pace or an all-out sprint clock.

records.name: Single-Leg Balance
records.instructions: Stand on one leg, hips level and core braced; hold for the target time per side.

records.name: Assault Bike (Watts)
records.instructions: Hold the target power output (watts) on the air bike for the prescribed effort.

records.name: BOSU Squat Hold
records.instructions: Hold a quarter-squat on an unstable BOSU dome, staying centred for the target time.

records.name: Weighted Plank
records.instructions: Hold a rigid plank with a plate on the upper back for the target time.

records.name: Wall Sit
records.instructions: Sit against the wall at 90° knees, optionally holding a plate, for the target time.

records.name: Overhead Barbell Hold
records.instructions: Hold a loaded barbell locked out overhead for the target time.

records.name: 5-10-5 Pro Agility Shuttle
records.instructions: Sprint 5yd, back 10yd, through 5yd, changing direction sharply; log the time.

records.name: Agility Ladder Drill
records.instructions: Quick-feet ladder pattern for the target time, staying light on the balls of the feet.

records.name: Cone Sprint Drill
records.instructions: Repeated accelerations between cones over the target distance.

records.name: Outdoor Run
records.instructions: Run holding the target pace (min/km).

records.name: Zone 2 Bike Ride
records.instructions: Steady aerobic ride keeping heart rate at the target zone (bpm).

feedback.note: Completed all 4 sets with high speed. Recommend adding 2.5kg next session.
Pushed the weight easily. Ready for 65kg next week.
Felt form breaking on last 2 reps. Keep weight at 50kg.
Shoulders shrugging too early. Keep elbows in.

sets.note: Left arm weaker on last set

feedback.note: Felt slight pinching in right shoulder. Ceased after 2 sets.
Great mind-muscle connection. Strong back activation.
Moved 24kg easily on the final set. Increase starting weight next session.
Gassed by 15 cal — drop the target to 15 next session.
